Cookie Notice

This site uses essential and analytics cookies to improve functionality and performance. By continuing to use this site, you consent to the use of cookies as described in our Privacy Policy.

Customise Consent Preferences

We use cookies to help you navigate efficiently and perform certain functions. You will find detailed information about all cookies under each consent category below.

The cookies that are categorised as "Necessary" are stored on your browser as they are essential for enabling the basic functionalities of the site. ... 

Always Active

Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.

Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.

Performance cookies are used to understand and analyse the key performance indexes of the website which helps in delivering a better user experience for the visitors.

Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customised advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyse the effectiveness of the ad campaigns.

Start your journey

Opioid addiction treatment

Let’s work together to find you the right combination of counseling, community support, and life-saving medication.

Learn more »

Alcohol addiction treatment

Work with a care team who understands your journey. If medication is part of your recovery plan, we can help with that too.

Learn more »

Mental health care

We’ve got you covered with support to help you manage co-occurring conditions.

Learn more »

Responsive care

We’re here to treat the whole you. From STI care to pain and fevers, we’ll respond to your health needs. 

Learn more »

How does it work?

We’re ready when you are to make this as fast and easy as possible.

A quick intro call to help us help you

You’ll tell us about yourself and your health concerns. We’ll tell you about our treatment program.

Chat with a healthcare provider

If we sound like the right fit, we’ll dial-in a member of our care team right away.

Start treatment that same day

We’ll get you a prescription, schedule your first counseling visit, and help you start feeling better today.

Learn more

It’s all covered by insurance

Our treatment is included in the benefits of your Medicaid, Medicare, or other health insurance plan.

No insurance? No worries. We’ll work with you—and we never deny anyone care.
